sourceAssessment.result: _TracedFailures records first detected exception by identity using is None, independently retains first unsafe source and preallocates fixed-message OwnedCleanupError before child acquisition. Any failed settlement or unreturned acquisition forces unsafe carrier regardless of earlier body or later stream/restoration failure. Captured OwnedCleanupError from other phases cannot be downgraded. Successful result cannot return after recorded failure.

Order is launch/callback/communicate/result construction, settlement, stdout, stderr, restoration. Falsey exceptions remain first. This is not global concurrent chronology. Initial subreaper setup remains outside child-acquisition capture; arbitrary asynchronous interruption/allocation failure is not exhaustively contained.

Returned-process settlement retains original returncode-before-signal decision, missing-group handling and a single original wait. Already-reaped PID/PGID is never signaled. Five-second wait, separate five-second adopted deadline, waitpid(-1, WNOHANG), 0.01-second sleep, launch/communicate/prctl calls and timeout arguments are unchanged. Standalone sequential child ownership assumption remains required; no unrelated child scope is newly authorized.

Original stream slots are set to None before close; next eligible stream is attempted after failure. The same aliased stream object is closed at most once. A thrown close is not proof of release. Restoration is attempted once after earlier failures. First settlement failure still stops its sequence; no new kill/wait/reap retries. Restoration-only failure after normal cleanup blocks success without inventing unsettled children.

proof_directory is unchanged. It retains on OwnedCleanupError, including ambiguous start and settlement failures now protected from masking; ordinary body failure after cleanup retains prior removal policy. The directory tests use inert filesystem adapters, not actual durable storage.

Unsafe carrier arguments/public message are fixed. Exact original objects are private attributes, not public report data. Holder repr omits contents. Both holder and OwnedCleanupError refuse standard pickle protocols, including exception __dict__ traversal, with fixed TypeError from None. Re-raises suppress normal cause/context printing; attributes, __context__ and tracebacks remain inspectable by trusted same-process code. No durable journal or hostile-process secrecy claim.

Conservative retention does not recover a child for which Popen never returned ownership. No numeric PID rediscovery, fabricated cleanup or retry was added. Initial setup uncertainty, hidden resources, destructor effects, retained error lifetime, actual EXITKILL/process-group correctness and surviving recovery owner remain open.
